title: What’s New: Financial Reporting (for Administrators) (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Financial Report User Roles and Telemetry
Sensitive Field Monitoring and Data Analysis

features.name: Telemetry on Financial Report Usage and Lifecycle Changes
features.description: Telemetry tracking for usage of financial reports and lifecycle changes to report definitions, available in Application Insights and Microsoft Purview.
caveats: Microsoft Purview data currently in preview

features.name: Change Log for Financial Report Definitions
features.description: Ability to track changes to report row and column definitions using change log, with documentation on tables that need change log setup.
caveats: Change log must be set up on specific tables for report definitions

features.name: Sensitive Field Monitoring for Financial Reports
features.description: Deluxe version of change log for financial report definitions that provides email notifications when changes are made to tracked values.
caveats: Requires additional setup beyond standard change log

features.name: Data Analysis for Financial Report Changes
features.description: Ability to analyze financial report definition changes using the data analysis feature with pivot capabilities to view changes by definition or by user.

features.name: Financial Report Permissions Documentation
features.description: Documentation on permission sets for viewing and editing financial reports, providing guidance for administrators.

features.name: Troubleshooting Financial Reporting Documentation
features.description: New documentation article for administrators to help troubleshoot financial reporting issues and unblock users.

features.name: Financial Reporting FAQ Documentation
features.description: New frequently asked questions page for financial reporting with commonly asked questions to help users and administrators.
